final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), all_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_avgs), above AS (SELECT avg_pic, ratio, avg_ratio FROM patient_avgs CROSS JOIN all_avg WHERE ratio > avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(avg_pic) AS average_of_average_pic, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(ratio - avg_ratio) AS average_excess_over_all_patient_average FROM above
